gloss: to get a taste for something (and want more)

definitions.gloss: to get a taste for something; to be encouraged by a past success (and want it again)
definitions.explanation: Having done well or got something easily once, to expect the same again and keep trying it. Often slightly critical, of someone who keeps exploiting a lucky break.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{勝|か}って→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧{味|あじ}をしめた。
examples.english: Having won once, he got a taste for it.

examples.japanese: {味|あじ}をしめた⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: Having got a taste for it, the cat started coming every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{前回|ぜんかい}→前回：11817_zenkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{買|か}えた→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{味|あじ}をしめて、⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{朝早|あさはや}く⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{並|なら}んだ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Encouraged by the bargain I got at the last sale, I lined up early in the morning again this time.

notes:
Conjugates like the ichidan verb しめる (usually written in kana; also ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{占|し}める→占める：11799_shimeru⟧). Most often in the past: ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{味|あじ}をしめて (having got a taste for ~).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{味|あじ}をしめる: to be emboldened by a success
- ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧{味|あじ}をしめる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: once someone has had a taste of it
- {味|あじ}をしめて⟦{二度|にど}→二度：09503_nido⟧、⟦{三度|さんど}→三度：15154_sando⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: getting greedy and trying again and again

WATCH OUT:
Not about the flavor of food. It does not mean 'to season'; for that, ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける.
